primaryChecks.text: So David assembled all Israel together, from the Shihor River of Egypt even to the entrance of Hamath, to bring God’s ark from Kiriath Jearim.
primaryChecks.previousContext: All the assembly said that they would do so, for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.
primaryChecks.nextContext: David went up with all Israel to Baalah, that is, to Kiriath Jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up from there God the LORD’s ark that sits above the cherubim, that is called by the Name.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 「River of Egypt」は河川名を含む境界表現で、国名Egyptの独立した用例とは確認できない。

primaryChecks.text: What one nation on the earth is like your people Israel, whom God went to redeem to himself for a people, to make you a name by great and awesome things, in driving out nations from before your people whom you redeemed out of Egypt?
primaryChecks.previousContext: LORD, there is no one like you, neither is there any God besides you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
primaryChecks.nextContext: For you made your people Israel your own people forever; and you, LORD, became their God.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 固定WEB 1CH 17:21 はEgyptを地理的な対象として明記する。
